TITLE:
Sleepy Morning Floral Bikini Hotel Bed 

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.
Slightly imperfect candid morning snapshot.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair with soft see-through bangs.
Slightly messy, tousled just-woke-up hair.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Naturally very full bust.
Natural feminine curves.
Realistic anatomy.

OUTFIT:
A delicate pale-blue floral two-piece bikini with an elegant feminine design.
Fitted bikini top with thin shoulder straps, softly shaped cups, delicate scalloped trim, and a tiny center bow detail.
Matching low-rise bikini bottoms with slim side straps and subtle decorative trim.
Lightweight matte fabric with fine realistic texture.
Refined, delicate swimwear styling rather than sporty beachwear.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
A modern upscale Japanese hotel room in the morning.
She is sitting on a large hotel bed with heavily rumpled white sheets, pillows, and duvet.
The bed looks naturally messy after sleeping.
A few casually discarded clothes rest near the edge of the bed.
Warm neutral interior with an upholstered headboard, bedside lamp, lounge chair, small table, flowers, and a large window overlooking the city.
Soft morning daylight enters through the window.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Sitting naturally on the messy bed with relaxed legs.
One hand lightly touches her tousled hair as if she has just woken up.
The other hand rests naturally on the bed.
Slightly sleepy posture.
Head gently tilted.
Soft direct eye contact with a small relaxed smile.
Natural candid just-woke-up atmosphere.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Eye-level perspective.
Medium-full portrait framing.
Close handheld smartphone distance.
Natural perspective without body distortion.
Enough background visible to clearly establish the hotel room.

LIGHTING:
Soft natural morning light from the window.
Warm bedside lamp providing subtle ambient fill.
Gentle realistic shadows.
No studio lighting.

DETAILS:
Messy loose hair strands.
Natural skin texture.
Realistic bikini fabric and folds.
Deep wrinkles and uneven folds throughout the white bedding.
Pillows and duvet casually displaced from sleeping.
Authentic lived-in hotel-room details.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No excessive beauty filtering.
No perfectly made bed.
No staged showroom appearance.
No exaggerated body proportions.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
